<!--
WHAT THIS FILE IS
  The evaluation dashboard. Reads from deliverable/results/<arm_slug>/{scoreboard,covariates,
  predictions}.csv -- see .posit/assistant/skills/dm1-results-integration/SKILL.md
  for the exact contract. Swap in real team results by writing files matching
  that schema; nothing else here needs to change.

  Render with: quarto render deliverable/templates/dashboard/index.qmd
-->

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(rprojroot)
library(ggplot2)

root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)
arms <- c(mexiletine = "Mexiletine", oligonucleotide = "Oligonucleotide", tideglusib = "Tideglusib")

read_arm <- function(slug, file) {
  path <- file.path(root, "deliverable", "results", slug, file)
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
}

scoreboard_all   <- bind_rows(lapply(names(arms), read_arm, file = "scoreboard.csv"))
covariates_all   <- bind_rows(lapply(names(arms), read_arm, file = "covariates.csv"))
predictions_all  <- bind_rows(lapply(names(arms), read_arm, file = "predictions.csv"))

pred_vs_obs_plot <- function(arm_name) {
  d <- predictions_all |> filter(arm == arm_name)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(plotly_empty() |> layout(title = "No predictions yet for this arm"))
  lims <- range(c(d$observed, d$predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = observed, y = predicted, color = method)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2.6) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = lims) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = lims) +
    labs(x = "Observed", y = "Predicted", color = "Method") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
  ggplotly(p, height = 430) |> layout(autosize = TRUE, margin = list(t = 10))
}

metrics_table <- function(arm_name) {
  scoreboard_all |>
    filter(arm == arm_name) |>
    select(Method = method, Type = method_type, Tuned = tuned, RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae, `R2` = r2) |>
    datatable(options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE), rownames = FALSE) |>
    formatRound(columns = c("RMSE", "MAE", "R2"), digits = 3)
}

covariate_table <- function(arm_name) {
  covariates_all |>
    filter(arm == arm_name) |>
    select(Method = method, Covariate = covariate, Value = value, Type = value_type, Rank = rank) |>
    arrange(Method, Rank) |>
    datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10), rownames = FALSE) |>
    formatRound(columns = "Value", digits = 3)
}
```
